author: Steve Shannon
title: Tuscaloosa Area Scam Alert - NewsBreak
text:
By Steve Shannon ,
5 hours ago
There is a new Medicare scam making the rounds in the Tuscaloosa area.
Download the WFFN Mobile App Now
A female with a foreign accent calls repeatedly, saying you need a new Medicare card.
She then asks for your card number. She calls repeatedly, attempting to get this information.
Make sure your older loved ones do not become victims of this scam.
NEVER give any personal information they request. If they were legitimate, they would have that information.
Please share to help spread the word.
Top Stories from the Tuscaloosa Thread (1/26 - 2/2) Eight of the Top Stories published by the Tuscaloosa Thread during the third week of 2026. Gallery Credit: (Stephen Dethrage | Tuscaloosa Thread) Luther Bernard Watkins in 2019 (Stephen Dethrage | Tuscaloosa Thread) 1. Judge Rules on What Can Be Heard at Murder Trial of Man Who Killed Tuscaloosa Officer A judge will allow jurors to hear that a Tuscaloosa police investigator killed in 2019 had agreed not to pursue the man who shot him when the murder case goes to trial next week. (Stephen Dethrage | Tuscaloosa Thread) 2. Tuscaloosa Tables Vote on Tax Incentive to Demolish Homes for New Restaurants & Stores The Tuscaloosa City Council voted on Tuesday to indefinitely table a vote on granting a tax incentive for a developer to demolish two dozen homes and build a shopping center featuring new-to-market restaurants and retailers. (Noah Lueker | Tuscaloosa Thread) 3. Rape Suspect Jailed in Tuscaloosa After Standoff in Hoover Over Revoked Bond A man accused of raping a juvenile in Tuscaloosa County in 2020 is back in jail after his bond was revoked, leading to a standoff at a Hoover hotel on Monday. (Stephen Dethrage | Tuscaloosa Thread) 4. Junior at Demopolis High School Dies in Saturday Crash Near Dayton The Demopolis community is again in mourning after another young student there was killed in a car accident this weekend. (photo provided by the Tuscaloosa Police Department) 5. Brothers Arrested for November Ambush Shooting in West Tuscaloosa Two young brothers have been arrested and charged with attempted murder for their alleged roles in an "ambush-style" shooting that led to a gunfight in West Tuscaloosa late last year. (submitted by candidate) 6. Businessman & Former Football Pro Enters Race for Tuscaloosa Council Seat A businessman and former professional athlete whose team won the Canadian equivalent of the Super Bowl in the 90s has thrown his hat in the race for a vacant seat on the Tuscaloosa City Council. (Stephen Dethrage | Tuscaloosa Thread) 7. Special Election Set for Vacant Tuscaloosa City Council Seat The specifics have been settled for a spring special election in part of Tuscaloosa to fill a vacant city council seat. (rendering and logo from https://www.universitybeach.com/) 8. Northport Mayor Announces Town Hall With University Beach Developer Mayor Dale Phillips has arranged for a public town hall with the lead developer of University Beach, the $350 million lagoon resort soon to be under construction on Highway 82 in western Northport.
